scope: Retrospective comparison of current original candidates with reviewed spatial motifs. This does not assert that every candidate originated from a particular screenshot. No copied coordinates or artwork; no reference AI, collision or timing inference.

review.display: 6144x2560 source frames viewed as2048x853 tool previews; not native-sprite inspection
review.limits: Stills establish visible arrangements only. In particular,9/80 on pack1level4 does not establish which revealed cells were authored versus earned. Cyan band behavior and diamond/star AI remain unverified.

backgroundAsset.alt: A shaded limestone terrace and broad-leaf planter overlook a reflective basin and copper-green conservatory.

missions.departureFromReference: Redesign the detached-island motif as one interior return with two shared-tier keepers and a single outer-perimeter patrol. The screenshot's cyan stars do not establish patrol algorithms.
missions.distinctiveDecision: Wait for the outside patrol or leave for the shorter interior landing; distinguish reclaimed ground from universally safe ground.

missions.distinctiveDecision: Choose the next return by patrol timing and approach distance; an optional contact life detour never gates completion.

missions.departureFromReference: Combine a vertical non-scoring foundation spine with a detached shorter shelf. Explicitly define our foundation rule; do not infer the cyan band material from a still.
missions.distinctiveDecision: Choose a direct central return or a broad optional speed-detour approach, then link the shorter shelf.

missions.distinctiveDecision: Shape a newly reclaimed contour while planning a return away from the moving frontier patrol.

missions.distinctiveDecision: Extend the short arm or commit around the longer arm to alter both return distance and contour pressure.

missions.departureFromReference: Original curriculum extension from the earlier courtyard-return candidate, not a claimed numbered-reference recreation. A three-sided pocket combines known outer and frontier patrol roles.
missions.distinctiveDecision: Choose an inward pocket closure or an outward capture while keeping a usable approach under both patrol domains.

backgroundAsset.alt: Terraced botanical gardens and an old cedar overlook quiet jade water and a distant conservatory beneath a muted evening sky.

missions.departureFromReference: Combine an interior spine and offset islands, not copied symmetric coordinates. The optional finale combines known retainers and patrol roles and adds no mandatory mechanic.
missions.distinctiveDecision: Choose connection order before linking the far island; keep optional mastery separate from clear requirements.

evidence.scope: 84 complete preset/control/bonus-condition routes plus35 sampled delayed routes; paired-board checks use explicit untimed protocol. Omniscient feasibility search is not human pacing, meaningful alternatives, mastery completion or Team evidence.

Verify optional route-specific mastery before automatic quota completion.

Qualify final integrated source and public Pages deployment; retain original image and policy pins.
